{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |year =2018–19 |team =South Carolina Gamecocks |sport=Basketball |image =South Carolina Gamecocks basketball wordmark.svg |image_size =300 |conference =Southeastern Conference |short_conf =SEC |record = 16–16 |conf_record = 11–7 |head_coach =[[Frank Martin (basketball)|Frank Martin]] |hc_year = 7th |asst_coach1 =[[Perry Clark]] |asst_coach2 =[[Chuck Martin (basketball)|Chuck Martin]] |asst_coach3 =Bruce Shingler |stadium=[[Colonial Life Arena]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of South Carolina]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's head coach, [[Frank Martin (basketball)|Frank Martin]], was in his seventh season at South Carolina. The team played its home games at [[Colonial Life Arena]] in [[Columbia, South Carolina]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]].{{cite web |title= MBB |url=https://gamecocksonline.com/index.aspx?path=mbball|publisher= South Carolina Athletics |accessdate= June 7, 2019}} They finished the season 16-16, 11-7 in [[2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish a tie for 4th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2018–19 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|Gamecocks]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] finished the season 17–16, 7–11 in SEC play to finish in a tie for 11th place. They had 3 wins against ranked teams; No. 10 [[2017–18 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]], No. 18 [[2017–18 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]], and No. 20 [[2017–18 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]]. They defeated [[2017–18 Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball team|Ole Miss]] in the first round of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing in the second round to [[2017–18 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
